newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares continue bullish trade.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares continue bullish trade.

text.p: Norwegian shares broke new ground on Monday in a continuation of last week's bullish trade although there was not much news to inspire the market, dealers said.
The Total index rose 0.23 percent finish at 909.62 points, another life high, in healthy trade worth 638 million crowns.
"The market is simply bullish," one dealer said. "I believe the market will continue to go up unless there is a correction abroad -- and I don't think there will be one."
Other dealers were sceptical and expected a correction to come soon, but they have been waiting for some time now for their prediction to come true.
Food-based conglomerate Orkla continued a climb begun last week when investors bought consumer stock on the back of low interest rates. Orkla finished 1.16 percent higher at 435 crowns.
"Orkla is very solid and will keep on climbing," one dealer suggested. "We think it should hit 450 crowns, and maybe as high as 500 crowns, in a relatively short time."
Industrial group Kvaerner was another winner, its B share rising 2.79 percent to 221 crowns.
